# langsmith_datasets (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith datasets in a workspace, optionally filtered by name or data type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all datasets in the workspace.
data "langsmith_datasets" "all" {}

# List only chat datasets whose name contains a substring.
data "langsmith_datasets" "chat" {
  name_contains = "eval"
  data_type     = "chat"
}

output "dataset_names" {
  value = [for d in data.langsmith_datasets.all.datasets : d.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `data_type` (String) Return only datasets of this data type (`kv`, `llm`, or `chat`).
- `name` (String) Return only the dataset with this exact name.
- `name_contains` (String) Return only datasets whose name contains this substring.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID to list datasets from. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `datasets` (Attributes List) The matching datasets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datasets))

<a id="nestedatt--datasets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datasets`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the dataset.
- `data_type` (String) The data type of the dataset (e.g., `kv`, `llm`, or `chat`).
- `description` (String) A description of the dataset.
- `example_count` (Number) The number of examples in the dataset.
- `externally_managed` (Boolean) Whether the dataset is externally managed.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the dataset.
- `inputs_schema_definition` (String) JSON string of the inputs JSON schema definition.
- `last_session_start_time` (String) The start time of the last session associated with the dataset.
- `metadata` (String) JSON string of the dataset metadata.
- `modified_at` (String) The last modification timestamp of the dataset.
- `name` (String) The name of the dataset.
- `outputs_schema_definition` (String) JSON string of the outputs JSON schema definition.
- `session_count` (Number) The number of sessions associated with the dataset.
- `transformations` (String) JSON string of the dataset transformations.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID that owns the dataset.
